game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace, a seaside tavern terrace: the fisher must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Rule Duel: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel.
theme: Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace: a seaside tavern terrace
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: State tracing: Trace ACC after every instruction. subtract 12 from each value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 6, operand 12.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rule Duel' (Week 3 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Tavern Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the treasure chest from smugglers in Tavern Terrace: keep the duel_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: duel_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
